QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Unsettling Future 1
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bChristopher#k, a resident in #bTwilight Perion#k.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Christopher, a giant Black Mage statue is under construction in Twilight Perion. Is this part of Perion's nightmare? For now, see what you can find out.

#b#eStands with Bulls might know more.
QuestInfo.2: Talk to Stands with Bulls, a resident in Twilight Perion.

0.0: You want to know what happened to the city? What, are you blind? That cursed Black M--... er, we're building a statue to celebrate the #rGreat and Powerful Black Mage#k, obviously.
0.1: Perion is the highest point on Victoria Island. The statue will be visible... everywhere.
0.2: Almost the entire population of Perion is working on it. I used to be an explorer, but... a man's gotta eat, you know?
0.3: Look, I can't get caught slacking off. Why don't you go find somebody else to question?

no.0: Please, I don't want to get caught slacking off...

0.msg: (I won't be able to ask Christopher anymore. I should talk to someone else in Twilight Perion.)

1.0: What brings you here, to such a remote and desolate place?

yes.0: That's quite a memory you have for one so young... *cough* *cough* Give an old man his rest for a moment, then we will speak of these warriors.
